# AstrocyteInspiredRepair

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A repair mechanism for memristive AI hardware that mimics astrocyte signaling in the brain to dynamically adjust and restore synaptic weights in supervised learning systems. Provides a biologically plausible, hardware-aware fault tolerance method that is critical for maintaining accuracy in neuromorphic systems under device variability and degradation.
